rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-5 SIX-BOX: PREV best=iter-4 (cnn reg 2798p, K=5 tied prox+DC, scalar alpha, NO momentum, cosine LR + 16 epochs) hr 0.2378 ssim 0.886 psnr 36.44 (~20min, clear of LD-FBP floor 34.08). BREAKTHROUGH: iter-4 TRIPLED iter-1 hr at the SAME 2798 params via proper training - the solver was TRAINING-limited not capacity-limited. Now at hr 0.2378 still far below ITNet v1 (0.4398): the single-scale CNNReg has eff RF only ~7px, too small for Mayo correlated streak/low-dose noise. The limiting lever has FLIPPED from training (fixed iter-4) to CAPACITY. CHANGE (CODE: reg_type cnn->microunet, the EXACT iter-2 multi-scale 2-level micro-UNet 25889p at mu_channels=16; EVERYTHING else iter-4 byte-for-byte: K=5 single scalar alpha NO momentum NO per-step-alpha plain prox step cosine LR 5e-3->1e-5 16 epochs max_train_s=1080 train_n=200). HYPOTHESIS (CRUCIAL COROLLARY): iter-2 micro-UNet failed at hr 0 ONLY because undertrained at 8 epochs; under iter-4 16-ep cosine recipe the multi-scale capacity (coarse branch eff RF ~14px) now PAYS OFF, lifting hr above 0.2378 toward 0.44. Clean control vs iter-2: identical arch, only the trainer differs. WHY STABLE (not iter-3): recon DYNAMICS unchanged (same K=5, same single alpha, same plain step, cosine LR only DECREASES step from known-stable iter-4 lr); only the reg internal width grows; zero-init 1x1 head keeps reg(x)~0 at init so seed = iter-4 GD+DC. BUDGET: iter-4 ran 16ep K=5 200train in 1207s; micro-UNet ~2-3x per-reg-call FLOPs but per-step cost DOMINATED by unchanged DC term (fwd+back project), so extra conv/pool/upsample is small fraction; max_train_s=1080 hard backstop guarantees no overrun (cosine just stops short of eta_min). PARAMS: 25890 total = ~9x iter-4 capacity, still ~9x SMALLER than ITNet 233k. PREDICTED hr ~0.30-0.38., reg_type=microunet, n_iter=5, learnable_alpha=True, per_step_alpha=False, momentum=False, cnn_channels=12, cnn_layers=3, alpha_init=0.1, clip_max=0.05, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, cosine_lr_min=1e-05, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, mu_channels=16
